title: Shorts
description: The shorts `pnpm edit --shorts` made from one long video, written beside their folders and again as each one finishes.

asked.description: How many shorts were asked for. Fewer are made when the footage holds fewer distinct moments.

range.description: The shortest and longest a short may be, in seconds.

shorts.description: The shorts made so far, best first.

stopped.description: Why the run made fewer than it could: "cost" when Claude's cost reached the run's limit. Absent otherwise.

folder.description: Its folder beside this file, holding edit.mp4, edit.project.json and edit.srt as a normal edit writes them: 01, 02, …

source.description: The footage file it is cut from, as it was given.

start.description: Where its stretch of the file starts, in seconds.

end.description: Where its stretch ends, in seconds.

length.description: The length Claude chose for it within the range, in seconds: the target its video is cut to within 5 %.
